name: pwm_controller
description: Parameterized PWM controller with a synchronous counter, programmable period limit, programmable duty threshold, and combinational PWM output generation.

fixed_assumptions: All behavior is synchronous to clk.
reset_n is an active-low synchronous reset.
duty_cycle and period are treated as unsigned 8-bit configuration inputs.
When enable is high, the counter increments on each rising clock edge and wraps to zero after reaching period.
When enable is low, the counter holds its current value.
pwm_out is combinationally driven as (counter_value < duty_cycle).
If period is zero, the counter returns to zero whenever enabled so that the terminal condition is immediately satisfied.

feature_contracts.description: Synchronous active-low reset clears the counter output to zero.
With reset released and enable high, the counter advances and pwm_out follows counter_value < duty_cycle.
When enable is low, the counter holds its current value while pwm_out remains a combinational comparison of that held value against duty_cycle.
When the enabled counter reaches the programmed period value, the next state wraps to zero.

functionality: The module implements a programmable pulse-width modulation generator. It maintains an 8-bit counter that increments once per clock when enable is asserted, saturating by wrap-to-zero behavior at the programmed period boundary. The PWM output is high whenever the current counter value is numerically less than the programmed duty_cycle, and low otherwise. The exposed counter_value output reflects the current internal counter state continuously. All sequential state is cleared to zero on synchronous assertion of reset_n low.
responsibilities: Accept clock, reset, enable, duty cycle, and period configuration inputs.
Generate an 8-bit counter that advances only when enable is high.
Reset the counter to zero on reset_n low.
Detect the programmed period boundary and wrap the counter back to zero.
Drive pwm_out as a pure comparison of counter_value against duty_cycle.
Expose the current counter state on counter_value for observation.
reset_behavior: When reset_n is low on a rising edge of clk, the internal counter is synchronously cleared to 8'h00. Consequently, counter_value reads as zero and pwm_out evaluates according to the comparison 0 < duty_cycle, which is false only when duty_cycle is zero and true otherwise.
behavior_rules: On every rising edge of clk, if reset_n is low, set counter_value to 0.
On every rising edge of clk, if reset_n is high and enable is low, retain the previous counter_value.
On every rising edge of clk, if reset_n is high and enable is high, increment counter_value by one unless the current counter_value equals period, in which case load zero on the next state.
pwm_out shall be asserted when counter_value is strictly less than duty_cycle.
pwm_out shall deassert when counter_value is greater than or equal to duty_cycle.
counter_value is an observable registered output and must remain consistent with the internal counter state.
The design shall be fully synthesizable in SystemVerilog using standard sequential and combinational logic only.
No memory macros or multi-module hierarchy are required.
Timing intent is single-clock, single-register-path control with a nominal 50 MHz target.
